summary: Dependency-free searchable Combobox primitive with amber create-new row, pure filter module, and 29 behavioural tests; the four Gate 2 survivors are now caught, with no source change.
oracle: CI=true pnpm --filter @fxl-sales/web exec vitest run src/components/ui/__tests__/combobox.test.tsx -> 29 passed; full gate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check && CI=true pnpm test

red_confirmed: Two-stage red on the original build. (1) Test file alone: whole file failed to collect, 'Failed to resolve import "../combobox"'. (2) Then a throwaway stub (bare <button role=combobox>) so every test would fail on an assertion rather than on collection: 27/27 failed with real assertion errors. One test initially passed vacuously against the stub, 'closes on outside mousedown', because it asserted only that the listbox was absent; I added a precondition that the panel is open before the mousedown, after which it failed too. Only then did I implement. See `remediation` for the four inversions watched during the Gate 2 fix.
remediation: No source change: the committed blob for combobox.tsx is git hash b0cfae0d9803fbb23e6fe02dad253ad52e14d877, byte-identical before and after every mutation (verified with git hash-object plus an empty `git diff HEAD` on both source paths, and `git rev-parse HEAD:...` on the amended commit). Four additions, each inversion personally observed. (1) CREATE ROW INSIDE THE LISTBOX - added `expect(listbox()!.contains(createRow())).toBe(true)` to both 'shows the create row when nothing matches' and 'keeps the create row visible below the filtered options', plus a containment loop over every option row in 'opens on trigger click'. Mutation: moved the whole `{showCreate ? ... : null}` block out of the role=listbox div into the panel wrapper beside it. Observed: 2 failed / 27 passed, both new assertions reporting 'expected false to be true'. (2) CREATE ROW IS THE ACTIVE DESCENDANT - added `expect(activeDescendant()).toBe(createRow()!.id)` to 'shows the create row when nothing matches' and to 'selects the create row with Enter'. Mutation: replaced `navigableCount === 0 ? undefined : createIsActive ? createId : optionId(activeRow)` with `navigableCount === 0 ? undefined : optionId(activeRow)`. Observed: 2 failed / 27 passed, "expected ':r7:-option-0' to be ':r7:-create'" - the failure text itself shows the dangling-id bug, since no option row exists in that state. (3) DISABLED - replaced the vacuous test with 'does not open when disabled, and lets the key through instead of swallowing it', which drives a keydown (React does deliver keydown to a disabled button, unlike click) and asserts both that no listbox appears AND that `event.defaultPrevented === false`, because a disabled control must not consume ArrowDown; plus a new control test 'opens on a trigger keydown when enabled' proving that same interaction does open the panel, so the absence assertion carries weight. Mutation 3a, deleting `if (disabled) return;` from handleTriggerKeyDown: observed 1 failed, 'expected true to be false' on defaultPrevented. Mutation 3c, deleting both disabled guards: observed 1 failed, 'expected <div aria-labelledby=":rp:"...> to be null'. HONEST CAVEAT ON 3b: Verify's exact mutation, deleting the guard from openPanel ONLY, still passes and cannot be made to fail by any test. It is an equivalent mutant, not a coverage hole: openPanel is reachable from exactly two call sites, and both are already closed while disabled - React's shouldPreventMouseEvent suppresses onClick on a disabled button regardless of event target, and handleTriggerKeyDown returns at its own guard before ever calling openPanel. So that line is redundant defence with no input that can reach it. I left it in place rather than change source; see notes. (4) TRIGGER TOGGLE - added 'closes an open panel when the trigger is clicked again', asserting the panel closes, aria-expanded returns to false, focus returns to the trigger, and onChange is never called. Mutation: replaced `onClick={() => (open ? closePanel(true) : openPanel())}` with `onClick={() => openPanel()}`. Observed: 1 failed, 'expected <div aria-labelledby=":rq:"...> to be null'.
api_matches_plan: yes - all five combobox-filter exports and every ComboboxProps field match the plan's Component API signatures verbatim, so slices 06/09/10/12 are unaffected. Three small non-API notes: (a) clicking the trigger while the panel is open toggles it closed and returns focus to the trigger; the plan specified click-to-open only, which would have left a mouse user no way to dismiss the panel, since a click on the trigger counts as inside the outside-dismissal wrapper. Verify accepted this on merit as the WAI-ARIA pattern, and it is now pinned by its own test. (b) combobox-filter.ts additionally exports the const UNGROUPED_KEY ('__ungrouped__'), the value the plan already pins in the ComboboxGroup docstring, so the component and the module cannot drift on it. (c) combobox.tsx is 389 lines against the plan's Refactor guidance of 'roughly 260'. Its stated trigger is 'if the render body grows past that', and the render body is 138 lines; the total is driven by the 37-line documented public prop type plus the pinned exact class strings, and extracting a local ComboboxPanel cannot reduce a whole-file line count. Verify reviewed this explicitly and recorded 'length here is not a smell'.
tests_changed: none belonging to other slices - no existing test file was touched and no tracked file outside my three plan paths was modified. Within my own new test file, across both attempts: replaced the vacuous 'does not open when disabled' with a keydown-driven version plus an enabled control test, and added the create-row containment, create-row active-descendant, option containment and trigger-toggle assertions described in `remediation`. Two earlier corrections to the plan's own test expectations: the plan's step 6 expected type('NI') to yield exactly one row, but 'ni' also matches Valeria's description 'Clinica de Psicologia' via the spec'd label-plus-description search, so the implementation returning 2 rows was correct and the expectation was wrong; I switched to type('VINI') (still proves case-insensitivity and accent-stripping) and added an explicit assertion that the description line is searchable. And the plan's step 7 group-heading check used querySelector('#'+headingId), which throws a SyntaxError because React.useId ids contain colons; replaced with document.getElementById plus a panel.contains assertion. Net test count 27 -> 29.
notes: One thing for the human, arising from mutation 3b: `if (disabled) return;` in openPanel is unreachable dead code today, because both of its call sites already block while disabled. It is harmless and cheap insurance for any future programmatic-open call site, so I left it untouched rather than edit correct source during a test-only remediation, but it is the reason that one mutation is untestable rather than undertested. Flagging rather than fixing, since removing a defensive guard is a design call and not mine to make inside this slice. The bg-popover finding is assigned to slice 06 and I have left it alone as instructed. Slice 06 still owns all 17 NativeSelect call sites, both datalist fields, and the native number-spinner cleanup; SalesOpsApp.tsx was never touched. Verify's own probe file zz-probe-verify.test.tsx was already removed by Verify and the tree is clean apart from .vscode/ and nexo/runs/** which I did not stage.
